_comment: Reference numbers of the production setup since 1.0.0: Swift-1.5 checkpoint (slybase/Swift-1.5-Qwen3.8-27B-heretic-MXFP4-GPTQ) with the 1.0 launch flags (docker-vllm7.service on LXC 2408 carries them; gpu-window copies that unit), R9700 at the production 210 W, max-model-len 262144, util 0.98, FULL_DECODE_ONLY. 1.0.0 reference (README): KV 436,906 tokens (warm), greedy ~35.0 ms/step, GSM8K 200 0.84. The throughput / tokens-per-step / acceptance entries are EMPTY on purpose: the numbers of the former amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4 checkpoint (0.4.0) do not describe this setup, and an empty entry is skipped, not failed. They are filled by the first green night gate (accept.py --record-baseline-on-pass, committed with the stack PR) or by one by-hand calibration run against the 1.0.0 image (accept.yml: record_baseline). After that, every release moves the baseline forward.
_note_fast_vs_full: fast and full are NOT comparable: fast runs 24 requests at conc 1 and 8, full 48 at 1/2/4/8/16 (same engine, shorter run). Never measure a fast run against full numbers.
_note_startup: startup_s measures the environment (weight load 61-158 s on the same day), not the engine; the check is soft (hard: false).
